data.situation:
When the last visitor left, Maya carried her apron back through the hall. The donation box was still beside the photographs; the room plan now had two neat changes in blue ink. Jo thanked her at the door. On the bus, Maya thought of Ruth pulling out the spare chair and Jo bending over the room plan. She wondered whether the visitor with the letter had found her old friends. Monday, in my diary
I thought volunteering meant knowing all the answers. It turned out to mean asking better questions. I liked Ruth’s welcome and watched Jo mediate between the two groups. Next time, I would like to help at the exhibits. I will ask who is showing visitors around before I make another commitment.

readingBlocks.zh: 最后一位访客离开时，玛雅带着围裙穿过大厅。捐款箱仍在照片旁；房间图上多了两处整齐的蓝色改动。乔在门边向她道谢。在公交车上，玛雅想到露丝拉出备用椅子，以及乔俯身查看房间图。她想，不知道拿着信的访客有没有找到老朋友。

readingBlocks.en:
Monday, in my diary
I thought volunteering meant knowing all the answers. It turned out to mean asking better questions. I liked Ruth’s welcome and watched Jo mediate between the two groups. Next time, I would like to help at the exhibits. I will ask who is showing visitors around before I make another commitment.
readingBlocks.zh:
周一，日记
我原以为做志愿者意味着知道所有答案。结果它意味着问更好的问题。我喜欢露丝的欢迎方式，也看到乔在两组之间调解。下次我想在展览区帮忙。我会先问是谁带访客参观，再作新的承诺。
